sample_label: T2 frontend and runtime role-matrix integration sample

measurements.sensor: S1 runtime database plus S3 browser route tree
measurements.raw_evidence: Flyway V45 produced six child menus; administrator UI and role permission catalog rendered all six distinct routes.

measurements.sensor: S3 compiled frontend and authenticated browser profiles
measurements.raw_evidence: One-menu role saw only Window; read-only role saw six read pages without write controls; no-release role saw no release navigation; direct unauthorized URL returned Dashboard; 390x844 drawer showed only Dashboard.
limitation: Representative role profiles do not enumerate every possible permission combination.

measurements.sensor: S2 security tests plus authenticated API-backed page behavior
measurements.raw_evidence: Six security/schema tests passed and read-only pages loaded using distinct baseline and production-version authorities without write access.

measurements.sensor: S1 post-migration SQL counts plus S4 Java 17 reactor
measurements.raw_evidence: SUPER_ADMIN and RELEASE_ADMIN retained 6 child menus and 15 active actions; all 8 reactor modules passed.

measurements.sensor: S1 permission catalog plus S3 role switches
measurements.raw_evidence: Role permission tree grouped actions under each child and parent directory; saving child actions produced the expected child/parent route tree for temporary roles.

disturbances: The first V45 statement form was incompatible with MySQL self-reference rules; restore-and-retry with a self LEFT JOIN succeeded.
The first full test command selected Java 26; the project-required Java 17 rerun passed.
A stale cross-account tab was observed during sampling, corrected in auth session clearing, and the exact switch was re-tested.
coverage_gaps: Repository scope automation cannot run on the user-required rokey branch because it hardcodes feature/REQ branch naming.
Repository-wide governance remains red due to six unrelated pre-existing invalid ledger filenames.
